_comment: OpenAI rate card for Codex, USD per MILLION tokens. Edit freely; no code changes required. IMPORTANT: this prices tokens at OpenAI's regular API rates, which is NOT what a ChatGPT subscription charges. The dashboard labels the figure 'API-equivalent' for that reason - it answers 'what would this have cost through the API', not 'what were you billed'.
_buckets: Codex reports no cache-creation tokens (cache_write_input_tokens has been 0 on every event observed) and OpenAI's rate card has no cache-write line, so both cacheWrite entries are 0. `cacheRead` is OpenAI's cached-input rate, a tenth of the input rate. `input` is charged on the UNCACHED remainder only - the parser subtracts cached_input_tokens out of input_tokens, which OpenAI reports as a total including cache hits.
_fastMode: Fast/priority mode roughly doubles these rates. Codex does not record whether a turn ran in fast mode, so everything is priced at standard speed; heavy fast-mode use would run higher than shown.
_aliases: Model strings that appear in the rollout files but are a job title rather than a model name. They are priced as the target but keep their own identity in the charts.
